access_empty: You have no active document access.
access_intro: These documents are available to you until {expiresAt}.
access_pending_acceptance: Your access is approved, and {count} agreement(s) are waiting for you to accept. Your documents open as soon as you do:
access_verify_failed: This link is invalid, expired, or already used. Please submit a new request.
access_verify_intro: Select the button to confirm your request. The link works once.
admin_acceptance_due_days_hint: How long a requester has to accept an outstanding agreement before the approval lapses. Without a setting here, the deployment's default of {days} days applies.
admin_acceptance_scope_hint: Under company domain, one person's acceptance also satisfies the requirement for colleagues at the same company domain. This applies only to domains matched by an auto-approve rule or named explicitly by one — an operator's deliberate, informed widening, not the default.
admin_agreement_body_not_in_subset: This body contains content outside the supported subset: {nodeType}.
admin_agreement_default_template: Default agreement for the NDA tier
admin_agreement_import: Import a PDF or Word file
admin_agreement_import_dropped: Removed on import, because the agreement format cannot show it: {types}. Check the text before saving.
admin_agreement_import_failed: This file could not be imported: {reason}
admin_agreement_import_no_text: This PDF contains no text to import — it is probably a scan.
admin_agreement_no_effective_version: No effective version. Requesters cannot yet be asked to sign this agreement.
admin_agreement_retire_confirm: Really retire this agreement? Requesters will no longer be asked to sign it.
admin_agreement_version_already_publishe: This version has already been published.
admin_agreement_version_immutable: This version has already been accepted and can no longer be edited. Publish a new version instead.
admin_agreement_version_incomplete: Cannot publish: at least one enabled locale has no body yet.
admin_audit_intro: Every recorded event, newest first. Filters are part of the URL, so a filtered view can be handed to an auditor as a link.
admin_confirm_delete: Really delete? This cannot be undone.
admin_dashboard_intro: Pick a section above to manage what the trust center publishes.
admin_decision_error: That decision could not be applied. The request may already have been decided.
admin_error_pattern: An exact domain (acme.example) or one leading wildcard (*.acme.example).
admin_error_slug: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only.
admin_grant_blocked: Waiting on “{name}”, which has no version that can be shown{locales}. Nobody can accept it until a complete version is published.
admin_grant_default_days_hint: Used when an approval names no end date. Without a setting here, the deployment's default of {days} days applies.
admin_grants_intro: Who currently holds access, and until when. Revoking takes effect on the next download attempt.
admin_group_in_use: This group cannot be deleted while a grant still includes it.
admin_group_members_hint: Membership is edited on each document.
admin_integrations_egress_off: Event egress is switched off for this deployment (EVENT_EGRESS_ENABLED). Endpoints can be configured, but nothing is delivered.
admin_integrations_error_format: Choose a supported format. A generic endpoint needs EVENT_SIGNING_KEY to be configured.
admin_integrations_error_patterns: Enter at least one pattern of the form noun.verb or noun.*.
admin_integrations_error_url: This URL cannot be used as a destination.
admin_integrations_high_frequency: “{pattern}” matched {count} events in the last seven days, above {threshold}. This channel will be written to more often than it is read.
admin_integrations_intro: Where this deployment posts events. Endpoints live in the database; whether this deployment calls out at all is set in the environment.
admin_integrations_patterns_hint: One per line. An exact action name (access_request.approved) or one trailing wildcard segment (access_request.*).
admin_integrations_secret_missing: EVENT_SIGNING_KEY is not configured, so there is no secret to derive.
admin_integrations_test_failed: The test event was not delivered: {reason}.
admin_priority_hint: Lower runs first. Ties go to the more specific domain.
admin_purge_already: This record has already been purged.
admin_purge_confirm: Really purge? The personal data is erased immediately and cannot be recovered.
admin_purge_intro: Blanks this person's name, company, and email address, and removes their name, address, and device from the audit log. The audit events themselves survive, without a link to the person. Grants and requests keep their history. This cannot be undone.
admin_requesters_intro: Everyone who has verified an email address. Purged records stay listed and are marked as such.
admin_requests_intro: Verified access requests. Unconfirmed requests do not appear here.
admin_requirement_no_default: A document at the NDA tier is in scope and no default agreement is configured. Set one under Settings → Access before approving.
admin_requirement_unrenderable: One of the agreements has no version that can be shown in every language. Publish a complete version, or waive it.
admin_rule_pattern_hint: An exact domain (acme.example) or one leading wildcard (*.acme.example).
admin_rule_tiers_hint: Whole tiers this rule may approve automatically. None means it approves no blanket.
admin_rules_intro: Rules decide a request by the sender's domain, before anyone reads it. Listed in the order they are considered.
admin_term_from_acceptance: The term starts when the requester accepts, not today.
agreement_accept: I have read and accept this agreement
agreement_erasure_notice: Accepting stores a record of this agreement: your name as typed, your email address, your company, the exact text you accepted, and the time, IP address and browser you accepted from. We keep it for as long as the law requires us to be able to prove the agreement, and it is not erased when you ask us to erase your other data. Everything else about you is erased on request.
agreement_moved: This agreement changed while you were reading it. Please read the current version and accept again.
agreement_typed_name_required: Please type your full name to accept.
agreement_unavailable: This agreement cannot be shown right now. Please contact us — nothing is expected of you until it can be.
agreements_intro: Before your documents open, please read and accept the following.
agreements_none: You have nothing left to accept.
confirm_done_body: You will now receive notifications for your topics. Every email carries a link to change them or unsubscribe.
confirm_expired: This link has expired or has already been used. Please subscribe again.
confirm_intro: Please confirm that you would like to receive notifications.
controls_empty: No controls have been published yet.
controls_intro: Technical and organisational measures, grouped by area.
documents_empty: No documents have been published yet.
documents_intro: Every attestation, agreement, and policy — public or on request.
documents_nda_notice: Available only after a non-disclosure agreement is signed.
download_confidentiality_notice: Confidential. Provided under an access grant to the named recipient; do not redistribute.
faq_empty: No questions have been published yet.
faq_intro: Answers to the questions we are asked most often.
mail_acceptance_expiring_body:
Your request was approved, and one agreement is still waiting for your acceptance. Until you accept it, the documents stay closed.

This approval lapses on {dueAt}. Accepting takes a minute: open your access page and read the agreement there.

If you no longer need the documents, you can ignore this and the approval will lapse on its own.
mail_acceptance_expiring_subject: One step left before your documents open
mail_grant_expiring_body:
Your access to {documentCount} document(s) expires on {expiresAt}.

If you still need it, reply to this message and we will extend it.
mail_nda_record_body:
Thank you. Attached is the record of your acceptance of {agreement}: the text as it stood when you accepted it, and the details of the acceptance itself.

Keep it for your files. You can also download it again at any time from your access page.
mail_request_acceptance_required_body:
Your request has been approved. Before you can open {documentCount} document(s), please read and accept {agreementCount} agreement(s).

Continue here:
{url}

This link works once and expires shortly.
mail_request_acceptance_required_subject: One step left before your document access
mail_request_approved_body:
Your request has been approved. You have access to {documentCount} document(s) until {expiresAt}.

Open your documents:
{url}

This link works once and expires shortly.
mail_request_denied_body:
We are unable to grant this request.

{reason}
mail_staff_new_request_body:
A new access request is waiting for triage:
{url}
mail_verify_request_body:
You asked for access to documents on our Trust Center.

Confirm your email address to continue:
{url}

This link works once and expires shortly. If you did not make this request, ignore this message — nothing happens until the link is used.
manage_gone_body: This address will no longer receive notifications.
manage_intro: Change your topics and language, or unsubscribe.
portal_no_sections: No content has been published on this trust center yet.
portal_tagline: Security, privacy, and compliance — documented and verifiable.
record_intro: Version {version}. The text reproduced below is the exact text that was presented and accepted, and its SHA-256 is recorded at the end of this document.
request_error_throttled: Too many requests. Try again later.
request_intro: Tell us who you are and which documents you need. We will email you a link to confirm your address.
request_justification: What do you need these for?
request_none_available: No documents are currently available on request.
request_requires_agreement: an agreement is required before this opens
request_submitted_body: If that address can receive mail, a confirmation link is on its way. The link works once and expires shortly.
subprocessors_intro: Every provider processing personal data on our behalf.
subscribe_error_email: Please enter a valid email address.
subscribe_error_throttled: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
subscribe_error_topics: Please choose at least one topic.
subscribe_intro: Get an email when something changes. Choose the topics you care about.
subscribe_submitted_body: If that address can be used, an email is on its way. Please confirm your subscription in it.
updates_empty: No updates have been published yet.
updates_intro: Changes to documents, certifications, and subprocessors.
